Name: BULLET_SHOTGUN_PARAM_ST
Description: Pellet pattern for shotgun-style shots: a fixed position for each of up to 36 bullets, plus a random position error applied to them.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Coordinate Error Direction
Fields.Description: Direction in which the random position error is applied.

Fields.Name: Coordinate Error Amount
Fields.Description: Size of the random position error. In metres.
